description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on testing CRUD operations and data retrieval related to Buzz posts, shares, comments, and media, using PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: BuzzDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing the BuzzDao data access object methods related to Buzz posts, shares, comments, and media in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and loads test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Verifies fetching of Buzz feed posts with specific filter parameters and checks data integrity against expected results.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Checks the total count of Buzz feed posts returned by the DAO based on filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of photo IDs associated with a specific Buzz post.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPost
methods.description: Validates saving a new Buzz post including timestamp assignment and employee association.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzShare
methods.description: Verifies creating and persisting a Buzz share, including validation of comments, likes, timestamps.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Tests the saving process of a Buzz video link associated with a post.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Tests the persistence and retrieval of a Buzz photo, including file content verification.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost1
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a Buzz post and cleanup of associated shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost2
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a Buzz post and its associated photos and shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost3
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a Buzz post and linked video when applicable.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Checks removal of a Buzz share and validation of associated post and shares count.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare2
methods.description: Checks deletion of a Buzz share and related media, with post reference validation.

methods.name: testGetBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a Buzz share object by post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList1
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all shares for a specific post, validating employee and post associations.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList2
methods.description: Ensures empty response for posts with no shares.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount1
methods.description: Tests counting shares for a specific post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount2
methods.description: Ensures zero count for posts with no shares.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Validates fetching of a comment by its ID including text and like count.

methods.name: testGetBuzzComments
methods.description: Tests retrieval of comments associated with a specific share ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Verifies count of comments for a shared post.
